import importlib

geometry = importlib.import_module("model.hyperbolic")
model_module = importlib.import_module("model.model")


class GeometryGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_curved_distance_gradcheck_and_finite_difference(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.13, -0.07]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.21, 0.16]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        fn = lambda a, b: geometry.squared_distance(a, b, c=1.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(fn, (x, y), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))
        value = fn(x, y).sum()
        gx, = torch.autograd.grad(value, x)
        step = 1e-6
        xp, xm = x.detach().clone(), x.detach().clone()
        xp[0, 0] += step
        xm[0, 0] -= step
        fd = (fn(xp, y.detach()).item() - fn(xm, y.detach()).item()) / (2 * step)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(gx[0, 0].item(), fd, delta=2e-5)
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 1e-5)

    def test_flat_limit_has_exact_nonzero_gradient(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.1]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.05, 0.3]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        out = geometry.squared_distance(x, y, c=0.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(out, 4.0 * ((x-y)**2).sum(-1), atol=0, rtol=0))
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(out.sum(), (x, y))
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(gx, 8.0 * (x-y), atol=1e-12, rtol=1e-12))
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(gy, -gx, atol=1e-12, rtol=1e-12))
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 0.1)

    def test_projection_and_coincident_distance_are_finite(self):
        point = torch.tensor([[1.2, -0.4]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        projected = geometry.project_ball(point, radius=0.9)
        loss = projected.square().sum()
        grad, = torch.autograd.grad(loss, point)
        self.assertLessEqual(torch.linalg.vector_norm(projected).item(), 0.9000000001)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(grad).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(grad.norm().item(), 0.1)
        same = torch.tensor([[0.2, 0.1]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        zero_distance = geometry.squared_distance(same, same.detach(), c=1.0).sum()
        same_grad, = torch.autograd.grad(zero_distance, same)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(same_grad).all().item())

    def test_nan_input_is_not_silently_reported_as_finite(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[float("nan"), 0.1]], requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.zeros_like(x)
        result = geometry.squared_distance(x, y, c=1.0)
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(result).all().item())


class RQVAEGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _make_model(self):
        config = type("Config", (), {
            "hidden_sizes": (7,), "dropout": 0.0,
            "codebook_num": 3, "codebook_size": (4, 4, 4),
            "codebook_dim": 3, "curvature": 1.0, "radius": 0.9,
        })()
        torch.manual_seed(23)
        model = model_module.RQVAE(config, in_dim=5).double()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for codebook in model.rq.codebooks:
                codebook.normal_(mean=0.0, std=0.15)
        model.frozen_codes = torch.tensor([[0,1,2],[1,2,0],[2,0,1],[3,1,0]])
        # A nonuniform, detached epoch target tests the differentiable logits path.
        model.frozen_transport = torch.softmax(torch.randn(4, 3, 4, dtype=torch.float64), dim=-1).detach()
        return model

    def test_real_objective_backpropagates_to_encoder_all_codebooks_and_edges(self):
        model = self._make_model()
        embeddings = torch.tensor([[.2,.1,-.3,.4,.1],[-.1,.3,.2,.1,-.2],
                                   [.4,-.2,.1,.2,.3],[-.3,.1,.4,-.1,.2]], dtype=torch.float64)
        target_embeddings = torch.tensor([[.1,-.2,.3,.2,.1],[-.2,.1,.2,-.3,.4],
                                          [.3,.2,-.1,.1,-.2],[-.1,.4,.1,.2,.3]], dtype=torch.float64)
        r = torch.softmax(torch.tensor([[1.,0.,-1.,.5],[0.,1.,.2,-.5],
                                        [.4,-.2,.8,0.],[.1,.6,-.3,.2]], dtype=torch.float64), dim=1)
        total, rec, assign, _bal, transition = model(embeddings, edges=(target_embeddings, r))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(total).item())
        self.assertGreater(rec.item(), 0.0)
        self.assertGreater(assign.item(), 0.0)
        self.assertGreater(transition.item(), 0.0)
        total.backward()
        encoder_grad = [p.grad for p in model.encoder.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
        self.assertTrue(encoder_grad)
        self.assertTrue(all(g is not None and torch.isfinite(g).all().item() for g in encoder_grad))
        self.assertGreater(sum(g.norm().item() for g in encoder_grad), 1e-8)
        for level, codebook in enumerate(model.rq.codebooks):
            self.assertIsNotNone(codebook.grad, "codebook level %d disconnected" % level)
            self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(codebook.grad).all().item())
            self.assertGreater(codebook.grad.norm().item(), 1e-9, "codebook level %d has zero gradient" % level)

    def test_global_balance_has_nonzero_parameter_gradient(self):
        model = self._make_model()
        inputs = torch.tensor([[.4,.1,-.2,.3,.1],[-.2,.3,.1,-.1,.2],
                               [.1,-.4,.3,.2,-.2],[.3,.2,.1,-.3,.4]], dtype=torch.float64)
        loss = model.population_balance(inputs)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(loss).item())
        self.assertGreater(loss.item(), 0.0)
        loss.backward()
        self.assertIsNotNone(model.encoder.layers[0].weight.grad)
        self.assertGreater(model.encoder.layers[0].weight.grad.norm().item(), 1e-10)
        for codebook in model.rq.codebooks:
            self.assertIsNotNone(codebook.grad)
            self.assertGreater(codebook.grad.norm().item(), 1e-10)

    def test_assignment_targets_are_stop_gradient_but_live_logits_are_not(self):
        model = self._make_model()
        embeddings = torch.randn(4, 5, dtype=torch.float64)
        self.assertFalse(model.frozen_transport.requires_grad)
        output = model(embeddings)[0]
        self.assertTrue(output.requires_grad)
        output.backward()
        self.assertTrue(any(p.grad is not None and p.grad.norm().item() > 0
                            for p in model.encoder.parameters()))
        self.assertIsNone(model.frozen_transport.grad)

    def test_nan_model_input_produces_nonfinite_objective(self):
        model = self._make_model()
        embeddings = torch.randn(4, 5, dtype=torch.float64)
        embeddings[0, 0] = float("nan")
        output = model(embeddings)[0]
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(output).item())
